{"policy":"permit (
    principal,
    action == Action::"readNamespaceSecret",
    resource is NamespaceSecret
)
when {
    (
        (principal is User &&
         resource has ownerUser &&
         resource.ownerUser == principal)
        ||
        (principal is ServiceAccount &&
         resource has ownerServiceAccount &&
         resource.ownerServiceAccount == principal)
    ) &&
    principal.clearance >= resource.sensitivity &&
    context.currentTime < context.serviceAccountToken.expiresAt
};"}

{"policy":"permit (
    principal is User,
    action == Action::"sendCommand",
    resource is Command
)
when {
    (principal.roles.contains(Role::"operator") ||
     principal.roles.contains(Role::"technician") ||
     principal.roles.contains(Role::"fleetAdmin")) &&
    context.maintenanceWindow.permitted &&
    context.currentTime >= context.maintenanceWindow.startTime &&
    context.currentTime <= context.maintenanceWindow.endTime &&
    (resource.targetDevice.status == DeviceStatus::"active" ||
     resource.targetDevice.owner == principal)
};

forbid (
    principal is User,
    action == Action::"sendCommand",
    resource is Command
)
when {
    (principal.roles.contains(Role::"operator") ||
     principal.roles.contains(Role::"technician") ||
     principal.roles.contains(Role::"fleetAdmin")) &&
    !(context.maintenanceWindow.permitted &&
      context.currentTime >= context.maintenanceWindow.startTime &&
      context.currentTime <= context.maintenanceWindow.endTime)
};

forbid (
    principal is User,
    action == Action::"sendCommand",
    resource is Command
)
when {
    (principal.roles.contains(Role::"operator") ||
     principal.roles.contains(Role::"technician") ||
     principal.roles.contains(Role::"fleetAdmin")) &&
    resource.targetDevice.owner != principal &&
    (resource.targetDevice.status == DeviceStatus::"provisioned" ||
     resource.targetDevice.status == DeviceStatus::"decommissioned")
};"}

{"policy":"permit (
    principal is User,
    action == Action::"cloneRepository",
    resource is Repository
)
when {
    principal.roles.containsAny([
        Role::"developer",
        Role::"reviewer",
        Role::"maintainer",
        Role::"securityLead"
    ]) &&
    resource.topicTags.contains("regulated-data") &&
    resource.lifecycleStatus == RepositoryLifecycleStatus::"active" &&
    (
        principal.clearanceLevel == ClearanceLevel::"restricted" ||
        (principal.clearanceLevel == ClearanceLevel::"confidential" &&
            [ClearanceLevel::"public", ClearanceLevel::"internal", ClearanceLevel::"confidential"].contains(resource.sensitivityClassification)) ||
        (principal.clearanceLevel == ClearanceLevel::"internal" &&
            [ClearanceLevel::"public", ClearanceLevel::"internal"].contains(resource.sensitivityClassification)) ||
        (principal.clearanceLevel == ClearanceLevel::"public" &&
            resource.sensitivityClassification == ClearanceLevel::"public")
    )
};"}
